description: Project-level Claude Code settings for edopro-next. Two hooks: (1) PreToolUse blocks a `git push` that targets master or that would ship drift in the derived message/protocol tables; (2) Stop captures each session's final reply into .git/agent-inbox/<role>.md so Brain, Builder and Verifier can hand off without the owner copy-pasting reports. Each hook's own docstring states exactly what it does and its limits -- notably that the inbox hook never fires for a round run in a non-Claude tool, which this project deliberately prefers for Verifier. Interpreter is `python`: verified as Python 3.12.10 on the primary dev machine (Windows), which is also what tools/ and tests/ are run with there. A macOS/Linux host where only python3 exists needs both `command` strings changed; no single invocation is proven portable across both, so do not assume one direction is universally safer.
